findings.current: Répondues : {answered} sur {total}  (ASCII U+0020 before the colon)
findings.problem: fr style guide §Punctuation requires an espace fine insécable U+202F before ":"; the namespace's other colon strings (answer_aria, proposal.field_*) use U+202F.

English source renders both counts with `number, ::group-off`; the translator dropped the type and skeleton, so the argument no longer matches the source and a large count would not be rendered the way every sibling count in this namespace is.

The fr catalogue renders this concept as "Prioritaire" everywhere: ui.chat.asks.urgent ("Prioritaire.") and both ui.chat.ask_queue.chip.label_* urgent arms ("· Prioritaire"). The visible badge must carry the same word as the screen-reader sentence on the same card. "Urgent" is also byte-identical to English, which the repo's locale-parity guard (is not an English stub) rejects; no exemption was added, the term was aligned instead.

Past participle agreeing with the implied "questions"; some French purists prefer "Réponses données" for a question, but the namespace already uses "Répondu dans la conversation" and the form is common in UIs. Meaning unambiguous.
